scope: Read-only pinned GitHub source review; no controller, model, test, build, runtime or goal action. Private report is the only write.
inputs: Current scripts/run_os_goal.py, scripts/watch_os_goal.py and scripts/os_goal_resources.py bounded launch/identity/signal/profile sections

confirmed_issue.title: Proven pre-spawn log-open failure leaves durable ambiguous startup and prevents ordinary retry
confirmed_issue.trigger: No existing campaign leases or prior unresolved attempt; initial receipt persistence succeeds; os.open of the per-attempt log at line198 raises an ordinary recoverable OSError, for example transient EMFILE. No subprocess.Popen is attempted.
confirmed_issue.observed_by_source: STARTING/null-PID receipt is persisted at196. Log open198/fdopen199 are outside inner handler200-232. Exception reaches main, which reports FAILED but leaves durable receipt STARTING. status123-126 returns UNKNOWN for null PID unless durable status is FAILED. Subsequent start187-188 refuses EXISTING_OWNER even after resource pressure clears.
confirmed_issue.expected: A caught failure positively known to precede any spawn must durably identify a failed, unspawned attempt and permit a later explicit retry once existing leases and identity checks are clear.
confirmed_issue.smallest_fix: Include log acquisition/ownership in guarded pre-spawn failure handling; persist a FAILED receipt for proven no-spawn errors without depending on a usable log. Keep diagnostic logging best effort. Close any acquired log FD if fdopen fails.
confirmed_issue.uncertainty_boundary: Do not blanket-convert existing STARTING/UNKNOWN/null-PID receipts to FAILED. A crash across Popen can leave a child whose identity was not persisted. Preserve fail-closed UNKNOWN and identity reconciliation for ambiguous delivery or a possibly live child; no blind retry, automatic resume or pid/group kill.
confirmed_issue.meaningful_verification: Focused fake-process unit test injects log os.open failure after successful initial receipt persistence, asserts Popen never called and durable FAILED/statusFAILED, then restores log acquisition and verifies a later explicit start can make exactly one mocked spawn. A separate fdopen failure can check descriptor ownership. Retain existing uncertain-crash and live-receipt duplicate prevention assertions. No tests executed by this review.
confirmed_issue.test_evidence: Read incoming test source: it covers missing inhibitor, immediate child exits, simultaneous/live receipt prevention, unresolved around-Popen crash and pidfd stop; it contains no injected log-open/fdopen failure test.

ownership_stop_usage.startup: No outer retry. Start acquires overnight-start lock, checks watcher/worker leases and rejects live/unresolved prior receipt before spawn. Starts detached session with DEVNULL input, log output and close_fds. systemd-inhibit required with no fallback.
ownership_stop_usage.identity: Status requires launcher birth/session identity, watcher birth and same launcher session, worker birth and watcher parent plus matching watcher worker PID. ACTIVE/WAITING additionally require both campaign leases and matching phase/goal. Popen acknowledgement alone is not ACTIVE.
ownership_stop_usage.stop: Stop refuses without verified watcher; pidfd_open plus post-open birth/session revalidation precedes one SIGTERM to that watcher. Current watcher forwards normal signal to current worker/checkpoint path. No process-group signal or outsider ownership transfer.
ownership_stop_usage.usage: Helper adds no account/model fallback or new inference for status/dry-run; actual start enters existing launcher account/resource/usage and uncertainty guards. Hard-stop and usage exits receive no helper outer retry. Saved BLOCKED remains a normal stop; a new actual start is an explicit resume operation, not passive observation.
ownership_stop_usage.limitations: Source review is not a workstation inhibitor capability test or detached live identity proof. No new independent stop/usage defect was confirmed in this bounded review.

original_campaign.preserved: Original source/service/account/native/SDK/UNKNOWN holds, generic/exec replay/equivalent=false and notification/wait/process NO_GO remain unchanged. Harness repair does not release original remaining12 provider or integration inputs.
